messages.author: Rei Tanaka
messages.text: STD Thursday night is the replication window — protected, Femi only. Wednesday's day window is open, and the following Monday night is open.

messages.author: Ingrid Voss
messages.text: Two 120-minute certified loads fit one 4-hour window back to back; the approval says exactly that. ADHOC has no write grants — do not even think it.

messages.author: Femi Oyelaran
messages.text: If anyone wants the replication window displaced, that is my call and it costs us the catch-up egress. Ask first.
